name: gpu_stereo_depth
title: GPU stereo depth and optical flow
short_description: Dense stereo depth and optical flow on a camera sequence, on the graphics processor.

structured_text.description: Computes dense depth maps with semi-global stereo matching and dense optical flow for a bundled stereo camera sequence on the graphics processor, the accelerated perception step of robots, drones and depth cameras. The sequence and all parameters are fixed.
structured_text.metric_explanation: The score is the number of stereo frames processed per second, including depth and flow.
structured_text.value_interpretation: Higher is better. More frames per second means denser and fresher 3D perception at higher camera rates.
structured_text.reasoning: Dense matching builds and aggregates large cost volumes, which stresses GPU memory bandwidth and integer and floating point throughput in a way typical of real perception rather than graphics.
